definitions.gloss: steep slope; steep incline; sharp gradient
definitions.explanation: A slope or gradient that is sharply angled. Used in geography, civil engineering, mountaineering, and disaster prevention contexts.

examples.japanese: {急傾斜|きゅうけいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}った→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
examples.english: I climbed a steeply sloping road.

examples.japanese: {急傾斜|きゅうけいしゃ}{地|ち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{土砂崩|どしゃくず}れ→土砂崩れ：09257_doshakuzure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a risk of landslides on steep slopes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{急傾斜|きゅうけいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}{勧告|かんこく}→避難勧告：16642_hinankankoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|だ}される→出す：01087_dasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This area has many steep slopes, and evacuation advisories may be issued during heavy rain.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (steep, sudden) and ⟦{傾斜|けいしゃ}→傾斜：05447_keisha⟧ (slope, incline, tilt). Often appears in disaster prevention (⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧) contexts, as steep slopes are prone to landslides and mudflows during heavy rain.

Japan's mountainous terrain means {急傾斜地|きゅうけいしゃち} (steep slope areas) are officially designated and monitored under the {急傾斜地崩壊対策事業|きゅうけいしゃちほうかいたいさくじぎょう} (Steep Slope Collapse Countermeasure Program).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急傾斜地|きゅうけいしゃち}: steep slope area
- {急傾斜|きゅうけいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{斜面|しゃめん}→斜面：12870_shamen⟧: steeply inclined hillside
- {急傾斜|きゅうけいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}る→下る：03913_kudaru⟧: to descend a steep slope
- {急傾斜|きゅうけいしゃ}⟦{崩壊|ほうかい}→崩壊：09067_houkai⟧: steep slope collapse

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{傾斜|けいしゃ}→傾斜：05447_keisha⟧: slope, incline — the general term without implying steepness
- ⟦{急坂|きゅうざか}→急坂：22336_kyuuzaka⟧: steep hill — a steep hill on a road, more colloquial
- ⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧: cliff — a near-vertical drop, steeper than {急傾斜|きゅうけいしゃ}
